features: Hyper is a flagship performance rackmount server optimized for scale-out cloud workloads.
16 DIMM slots supporting up to 1TB of memory (6700E series CPU).
Flexible networking options with 1 AIOM networking slot (OCP NIC 3.0 compatible).
Breeze through high throughput workloads with PCIe 5.0 NVMe drive support.
Modularized and Tool-less design for easy serviceability.

CPU: Intel® Xeon® 6 6700 series processors with E-cores
Note: Supports up to 330W TDP CPUs (Air Cooled)

Max GPU Count: Up to 1 double-width or 2 single-width GPU(s)

Memory: Max Memory (1DPC): Up to 1TB 6400MT/s ECC DDR5 RDIMM
Max Memory (2DPC): Up to 1TB 5200MT/s ECC DDR5 RDIMM

NVMe: NVMe; RAID 0/1/5/10 support(Intel® VROC RAID key required)

LAN: 1 RJ45 1 GbE Dedicated BMC LAN port(s)

Power configurations: Power-on mode for AC power recovery

Hardware: Silicon Root of Trust (RoT) – NIST 800-193 Compliant

Drive Bays Configuration: Default: Total 8 bay(s) 8 front hot-swap 2.5" NVMe*/SAS*/SATA* drive bay(s)
Option A: Total 12 bay(s) 8 front hot-swap 2.5" NVMe*/SAS*/SATA* drive bay(s)
(*NVMe/SAS/SATA support may require additional storage controller and/or cables, please see the optional parts list for details)
M.2: 2 M.2 NVMe slot(s) (M-key 2280/22110/25110; VROC required for RAID)
